skill.name: code-review
skill.description: Review changed files for security, performance, bugs, and project standards using Git diff context and reference checklists.
skill.summary: Reviews Git diffs for security, performance, correctness, and project standard issues.
skill.author: DavidDworetzky

security_audit.summary: The static high and critical matches are instructional examples inside OWASP and ORM reference documents, not executable behavior. The Git helper only enumerates local changed files. One low semantic concern remains because the skill points to author-specific absolute paths outside the active repository.

remediation.issue: Author-specific absolute paths in review setup
remediation.suggestion: Replace author-specific absolute paths with repository-relative paths such as docs/agents.md and CLAUDE.md. Ask before reading files outside the current repository.

remediation.issue: Git helper accepts --commits without numeric validation
remediation.suggestion: Validate --commits as a positive integer before numeric comparison to avoid script errors and ambiguous review scope.

remediation.issue: Review instructions can imply automatic fixes
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that the assistant should ask before modifying code unless the user explicitly requests fixes.

content.user_title: Review Changed Code for Security and Quality
content.value_statement: Code changes can hide security, performance, and correctness risks. This skill reviews Git diffs with OWASP and ORM guidance.
actual_capabilities: Identifies changed files with Git diff guidance.
Reviews ORM performance issues such as N+1 queries and missing indexes.
Assesses logic, error handling, and type-safety risks.
Formats findings by severity with explanations and suggested fixes.
References project standards from agents.md and claude.md when available.
limitations: Depends on local Git history and available changed files.
Does not run tests or security scanners automatically.
Original project standard paths may need adjustment.
Findings depend on the assistant reading relevant context.

use_cases.title: Pre-Commit Review
use_cases.description: Review unstaged and staged changes before commit for bugs and security issues.

use_cases.title: Backend Security Pass
use_cases.description: Check Python and SQLAlchemy changes against OWASP and ORM performance guidance.

use_cases.title: Team Standards Check
use_cases.description: Compare changed files with project conventions before a pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current Git changes for security, bugs, and performance issues. Focus on findings that need action.

prompt_templates.title: Review Staged Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Review only staged files. Categorize issues as critical or recommended, and include fix suggestions for each.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Backend Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Python and database changes. Prioritize OWASP risks, SQLAlchemy query safety, N+1 issues, and missing indexes.

prompt_templates.title: Review Against Standards
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the latest commit against our project standards, OWASP guidance, and ORM optimization patterns. Explain each blocking issue with evidence.

output_examples.input: Review my uncommitted changes before I commit.
output_examples.output: Critical: potential SQL injection in user lookup. Recommended: add eager loading to avoid repeated post queries.

output_examples.input: Check staged backend changes for security and performance issues.
output_examples.output: No critical issues found. Recommended: add an index for the new foreign key and document the new model.

output_examples.input: Review the latest commit before release.
output_examples.output: Critical: unsafe deserialization in request handling. Suggested fix: use JSON parsing or verify signatures before loading trusted payloads.

best_practices: Run the review after tests pass so findings focus on code quality.
Provide the target branch or commit range when review scope matters.
Ask for separate security, performance, and standards passes on large changes.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as the only release gate for high-risk changes.
Do not ignore project-specific context files when standards matter.
Do not accept automated fixes without reviewing the changed code.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews changed files for security risks, performance issues, bugs, and project standard violations.

faq.question: Does it run my tests?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on review guidance and code inspection unless you ask the assistant to run tests.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Can it find OWASP issues?
faq.answer: It includes OWASP Top 10 review guidance and examples to help identify common vulnerabilities.

faq.question: Can it review database performance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for SQLAlchemy loading, query loops, counts, and missing indexes.

faq.question: What should I check before using it?
faq.answer: Confirm the changed file scope and adjust project standard paths for your repository.
